verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's order (product circle, then GROVE, headline, body, pills, CTA), but the headline is shrunk so much it barely leads, and the two pills are wider than the CTA and pull focus from it. The CTA is also pushed off to the right and the body copy is crammed under the circle. B has the strongest headline, but its right column stacks the CTA, both pills and the tilted badge at similar sizes, so the CTA has no priority and reads before the headline. Its body copy is tiny and sits last in the bottom-right corner, and the product circle is jammed into the bottom-left, so the reading order is jumbled.
